name: sfcc-smart-wallet
description: SFCC/SFRA cartridges for a stored-value wallet in USD (sandbox, not for live money): sandbox top-ups, wallet-only and split payments with holds and e-mail step-up codes, family members with limits, refunds to the wallet and a Business Manager wallet desk on a balanced double-entry ledger - with tests and illustrated docs.
author: Vedesh Reddy

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:isml && npm run lint:docs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
